name: companion-living-style
author: DaggerHashimoto
description: Give recruited companions, town AI and AI vendors varied costume looks, colours and supported same-job outfits, with town-themed looks in 34 major towns (a Costume Guide in each switches the theme off or on), townsfolk who sit to rest and show idle emotes, an outfit shuffle setting and optional Cold Bolt use for companions that already know the skill. Renewal only; enable Population Engine. Cosmetic styling does not create items or change equipment stats.

settings.label: Equipment Cold Bolt
settings.description: Companions of every class may cast Cold Bolt when they possess it. Healing stays higher priority. Requires the equipment to actually grant the skill.

settings.label: Style recruited companions
settings.description: Cosmetic appearances only; no items, stats or jobs are changed.

settings.label: Style ambient townspeople
settings.description: Applies to ambient AI on town maps. Vendors and real players are excluded.

settings.label: Style AI vendors
settings.description: Apply cosmetic looks to population-engine vendor AI. Their shops and goods stay unchanged. Regular NPC shopkeepers are not population AI.

settings.label: Town-themed looks
settings.description: Ambient townsfolk in major towns mix in costumes that suit the place (winter wear in Lutie, sailors in Alberta, sakura in Amatsu, and so on). About 60% of each costume slot comes from the town theme; the rest stays the everyday pool. A Costume Guide beside each town's Warpra or Kafra can switch one town's theme off or on. Companions and vendors are unchanged.

settings.label: Townsfolk sit and rest
settings.description: AI characters (not your companions) sit for about 30 seconds after roughly 90 seconds with no monster within 14 cells, so mostly in towns. The population engine stands them up before they walk or fight. Uses the engine's own rules, with no extra server scans.

settings.label: Townsfolk emotes
settings.description: Now and then, ambient townsfolk near you show an emote: a smile, a heart, an idea, a laugh. At most 2 every 5 seconds, only within 12 cells of you and only on town maps. Companions and vendors are left alone.

settings.label: Upper costume headgear
settings.description: Random hats and other upper-slot looks. An actual equipped costume in this slot takes priority. Recruited companions keep costumes you equip on them; ambient and vendor AI receive cosmetic overlays over their default looks.

settings.label: Middle costume headgear
settings.description: Random glasses, ears and other middle-slot looks. An actual equipped costume in this slot takes priority. Recruited companions keep costumes you equip on them; ambient and vendor AI receive cosmetic overlays over their default looks.

settings.label: Lower costume headgear
settings.description: Random scarves, masks and other lower-slot looks. An actual equipped costume in this slot takes priority. Recruited companions keep costumes you equip on them; ambient and vendor AI receive cosmetic overlays over their default looks.

settings.label: Garment costumes
settings.description: Random wings, backpacks and other back-slot looks. An actual equipped costume garment takes priority. Recruited companions keep costumes you equip on them; ambient and vendor AI receive cosmetic overlays over their default looks.

settings.label: Varied hair and outfit colours
settings.description: Keeps the real job. Conservative outfit palettes for first jobs; other jobs keep their original colours.

settings.label: Supported alternate bodies
settings.description: Uses alternate outfits supported by official 1.7.0 for the same job family. Other jobs keep their original body.

settings.label: Outfit shuffle number (1–9999)
settings.description: Minimum 1, maximum 9999. This selects a stable set of outfits, not a delay or speed. Numbers 1, 5 and 9999 all use the same refresh timing. Save, then Apply & restart to change outfits.
